method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (12 Oct 2026): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA/e-Tax. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 12 Oct 2026: OECD Global Minimum Tax and GloBE Model Rules pages (latest substantive package still 11 Sep 2026 Administrative Guidance / GIR / Full Legislative Review). No new OECD Pillar Two releases since the 8 Oct refresh.
coverage.HK: Checked 12 Oct 2026: IRD What's New (latest entries 8 Oct address-change notice and 30 Sep fraud alert — neither Pillar Two) and the IRD global minimum tax / HKMTT page. No new Pillar Two items; Phase 2 of the Pillar Two Portal still stated as Q4 2026.
coverage.SG: Checked 12 Oct 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page, MOF newsroom, SSO Bill No. 22/2026, and secondary tracker confirmation. No presidential assent or gazetting of the Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 found; nothing new since the 6 Oct parliamentary passage already catalogued.
coverage.JP: Checked 12 Oct 2026: NTA 新着情報, NTA global minimum tax site, and e-Tax 多国籍企業情報の報告コーナー. Added NTA 趣旨説明 for the 7 Aug 2026 IIR/QDMTT circular, published 9 Oct 2026. e-Tax GIR recording guidelines still show the September 2026 update already catalogued; no further GIR schema change.
